errors.title: Python version too old
errors.what: agenticcarekit requires Python 3.11 or newer.
errors.why: the kernel uses typing and tomllib features introduced in 3.11.
errors.fix: uv python install 3.12 && uv run ack doctor

errors.title: Ollama is not installed
errors.what: no ollama binary was found on PATH.
errors.why: the local model path runs through the Ollama daemon.
errors.fix: brew install ollama   # or: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh

errors.title: Ollama daemon is not running
errors.what: the ollama binary exists but the daemon did not answer on 127.0.0.1:11434.
errors.why: model pulls and generation need the daemon up.
errors.fix: ollama serve   # then re-run your command

errors.title: Microphone dependency not installed
errors.what: the local mic adapter needs the optional sounddevice package and it is not installed.
errors.why: audio capture is optional — the voice loop runs fully offline against MockASR without it.
errors.fix: uv pip install sounddevice   # or use MockASR / the Twilio adapter

errors.title: Optional extra not installed
errors.what: a command needs an optional dependency group that is not installed (e.g. the [serve] extra).
errors.why: heavy optional dependencies stay out of the core install; the feature names its extra instead.
errors.fix: uv pip install "agenticcarekit[serve]"   # the error's fix line names the exact extra

errors.title: Not enough disk space for the selected model
errors.what: free disk at the model directory is below model size × 1.15.
errors.why: a partial pull wastes bandwidth and leaves a corrupt blob.
errors.fix: free up space, or pick a smaller model: ack init --model gemma4:e2b

errors.title: Not enough RAM for the selected model
errors.what: available RAM is below the model's working-set requirement (size / 0.6 rule).
errors.why: a model that swaps is slower than a smaller model that fits.
errors.fix: pick a smaller model: ack init --model gemma4:e2b   # or use a hosted primary

errors.title: Model variant does not fit this platform
errors.what: the selected variant targets different hardware (e.g. an -mlx tag off Apple Silicon).
errors.why: -mlx builds run only on Apple Silicon; CUDA-sized picks assume an NVIDIA GPU.
errors.fix: let detection choose: ack init   # or pick the base tag, e.g. gemma4:e4b

errors.title: Project root not writable
errors.what: agenticcarekit needed to create a file under the project root and the filesystem refused.
errors.why: read-only mounts, permissions, or a missing directory.
errors.fix: ack serve --path <a directory you can write to>

errors.title: Model pull failed
errors.what: the model download did not complete.
errors.why: network interruption or registry error; pulls are resumable.
errors.fix: re-run the same command — the pull resumes where it stopped

errors.title: Provider request failed
errors.what: the provider returned an error or timed out.
errors.why: transient provider/network failure; the fallback chain covers this when configured.
errors.fix: check `ack doctor`, or configure a fallback: [model] fallback = "cerebras:gemma-4-31b"

errors.title: Network unreachable
errors.what: a network probe or provider call could not reach its host.
errors.why: offline machine, captive portal, or firewall.
errors.fix: ack demo --offline   # everything runs against mocks with networking disabled

errors.title: Provider API key missing
errors.what: a hosted provider is configured but its API key env var is not set.
errors.why: hosted providers authenticate via environment variables; agenticcarekit never stores key values.
errors.fix: export CEREBRAS_API_KEY=...   # presence is checked, the value is never logged

errors.title: Sidecar token rejected
errors.what: a request to ack serve arrived without a valid bearer token.
errors.why: every endpoint except /v1/health requires the local token so other local processes cannot drive the sidecar silently.
errors.fix: Authorization: Bearer $(cat .ack/serve.token)

errors.title: Context window too small
errors.what: the blueprint's required context exceeds the model's context window.
errors.why: long transcripts or documents will silently truncate otherwise — agenticcarekit refuses instead.
errors.fix: pick a 256K-context model: ack init --model gemma4:12b

errors.title: Tool calling not supported
errors.what: the blueprint requires native function calling and this model/provider pair does not declare it.
errors.why: prompt-hacked JSON is not a substitute; agenticcarekit only uses native function calling.
errors.fix: ack init --model gemma4:e4b   # all Gemma 4 tags declare tool calling via Ollama

errors.title: Model does not support a required input modality
errors.what: a request or blueprint needs an input modality (e.g. audio) this model lacks.
errors.why: native audio input is available on gemma4:e2b and gemma4:e4b only.
errors.fix: ack init --model gemma4:e4b-mlx

errors.title: Model does not support a required output modality
errors.what: the request needs an output modality the model cannot produce.
errors.why: Gemma 4 output is text only on every variant — speech output requires a separate TTS provider.
errors.fix: ack add voice   # wires a TTS provider next to the model

errors.title: Sensitive value blocked at egress boundary
errors.what: a Sensitive[T] value was about to reach a public-cloud provider with no redactor declared.
errors.why: sensitivity is a type, not a convention — un-redacted PHI never crosses the boundary.
errors.fix: declare a redactor: [policy] redactor = "healthcare.phi"   # or keep egress = "device"

errors.title: Declared redactor not found
errors.what: ack.toml names a redactor that no installed pack provides.
errors.why: the policy engine refuses to guess — a silently missing redactor would be an open boundary.
errors.fix: ack doctor --json | grep redactors   # then fix [policy] redactor in ack.toml

errors.title: Egress attempted above configured limit
errors.what: a provider with a broader egress class than [policy] egress was invoked.
errors.why: the project declared a stricter boundary than this provider satisfies.
errors.fix: use a device/trusted provider, or deliberately raise [policy] egress in ack.toml

errors.title: Invalid ack.toml
errors.what: ack.toml exists but could not be parsed or a field is malformed.
errors.why: usually a hand-edit; the file is meant to be edited, so errors name the exact key.
errors.fix: ack sync   # reconciles and rewrites a valid ack.toml, preserving your values

errors.title: ack.toml missing a required section
errors.what: [project] and [model] are required and one is absent.
errors.why: the runtime cannot pick a model or blueprint without them.
errors.fix: ack sync

errors.title: Invalid egress class in ack.toml
errors.what: [policy] egress is not one of device, trusted-network, public-cloud.
errors.why: the privacy boundary is defined over exactly these three classes.
errors.fix: set [policy] egress = "device"

errors.title: No ack.toml in this directory
errors.what: the command needs a project and none was found here.
errors.why: you are outside a generated project, or init has not run.
errors.fix: ack init

errors.title: Unknown blueprint
errors.what: the named blueprint is not installed.
errors.why: first-party blueprints are voice-care, care-copilot, on-device.
errors.fix: ack init --blueprint on-device

errors.title: Unknown pack
errors.what: the named pack is not installed.
errors.why: packs are discovered via entry points; an uninstalled pack is invisible.
errors.fix: uv pip install <pack-package>   # or: ack new pack

errors.title: Template rendering failed
errors.what: a blueprint template did not render.
errors.why: template and context drifted — this is a bug in the blueprint, not your project.
errors.fix: re-run with --json for the failing template path, and file an issue

errors.title: Tool declared without a mock
errors.what: @tool was applied with no mock implementation.
errors.why: every tool ships a mock — it is what makes `ack demo --offline` real.
errors.fix: @tool(mock=mock_yourtool, ...)  # return canned, realistic data

errors.title: Unknown tool permission
errors.what: a permission outside network/sensitive/writes was declared.
errors.why: permissions are a closed set so generated projects can reason about them.
errors.fix: use permissions={"network"} (or "sensitive", "writes")

errors.title: Structured extraction failed validation
errors.what: the model's output did not match the requested schema, and the single repair attempt did not fix it.
errors.why: extraction returns validated data or it fails — a half-parsed clinical record is worse than none.
errors.fix: ack demo --json   # `details` carries both raw outputs; tighten the schema or the prompt

errors.title: Eval golden set missing
errors.what: ack eval found no golden set for this blueprint/pack.
errors.why: evals score against committed golden files; none exist yet.
errors.fix: ack eval --init   # scaffolds a golden set from the pack's clinical eval sets

errors.title: Eval scoring failed
errors.what: the judge model call failed while scoring.
errors.why: judge runs use the same provider chain and can hit the same network errors.
errors.fix: re-run; or score offline against exact-match only: ack eval --offline

errors.title: Generated demo failed
errors.what: the project's demo exited non-zero.
errors.why: usually a missing model, a broken edit in app/, or a capability mismatch surfaced at run time.
errors.fix: ack demo --offline   # runs against mocks; then ack doctor for environment causes
